world.title: SpaceX’s Starship captured by launchpad arms in dramatic first
world.summary: SpaceX's Starship spacecraft successfully returned to Earth, being captured midair by giant mechanical arms at its launchpad. This event, occurring 22 hours after its launch, demonstrates the spacecraft's full reusability, which is essential for achieving rapid and cost-effective recycling. The landing took place at Starbase, with the Starship descending slowly through cloudy skies before being secured.

world.title: Indian student in UK jailed for 30 years for grooming 70 girls online
world.summary: Bilal Kazi, a 27-year-old Indian student at the University of Chester, has been sentenced to 30 years in prison for grooming at least 70 girls online. He was found guilty of manipulating these girls into performing sexual acts. The case highlights serious concerns regarding online safety and the exploitation of vulnerable individuals in digital spaces.

world.title: Meet the hooded pitohui, the world's poisonous bird whose feathers and skin carry a powerful toxin whose touch can leave humans numb; where to spot it
world.summary: The hooded pitohui, found in the tropical rainforests of New Guinea, is notable for its striking appearance and potent toxicity. Its feathers and skin contain a powerful toxin that can cause numbness in humans upon contact. This bird, with its vibrant orange-chestnut body and glossy black head and wings, exemplifies the paradox of beauty and danger in nature.

business.title: SpaceX’s Starship captured by launchpad arms in dramatic first
business.summary: SpaceX's Starship spacecraft successfully returned to Earth, captured midair by mechanical arms at its launchpad, demonstrating its full reusability. This event, which occurred 22 hours after launch, is significant for SpaceX's goal of rapid and low-cost recycling of spacecraft. The Starship descended through cloudy skies before being securely caught, marking a notable achievement in space technology.

business.title: 'I’m getting married next week': Employee says manager confirmed layoff days before wedding, shares ordeal
business.summary: A Qualcomm employee in India faced a career setback just days before his wedding when his manager confirmed his layoff. The news came as a shock during what is typically a joyous time. The employee shared his ordeal, highlighting the emotional impact of losing his job so close to the significant life event, complicating an already stressful period.

business.title: Nvidia Without Huang: What a Pause in AI Deals Means for Metals
business.summary: Copper prices fell to a four-month low, marking a potential fifth consecutive weekly loss. Traders attributed this decline to Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia, raising concerns over the impact on data center metals demand. However, analysts suggest that the larger issue may be related to AI financing rather than a decrease in chip orders affecting the market.

technology.title: Developers can humanise AI voice with pitch and prosody adjustments
technology.summary: Voice AI developers are enhancing text-to-speech (TTS) output by adjusting pitch, speed, and prosody to create more natural-sounding voices. This focus on voice quality aims to improve user experience across chatbots, audiobook platforms, and smart assistants. A more human-like voice helps users feel they are interacting with a helpful companion rather than a machine.

technology.title: The Best Gifts for the Dad Who has Everything
technology.summary: Finding the ideal gift for a dad who seems to have everything can be challenging. Editor-approved options include practical items and personalized gifts across various categories such as technology, kitchenware, and books. Despite their claims of not needing anything, it’s important to choose something special that acknowledges their significance in your life, making the gift-giving experience meaningful.

technology.title: Apple may launch three new iPhones in early 2027: iPhone 18, 18e and Air 2; what to expect
technology.summary: Apple is anticipated to launch three new iPhones in early 2027, including the iPhone 18, iPhone 18e, and iPhone Air 2, possibly in March. Upgrades may feature the A20 chipset, enhanced battery life, improved cameras, and iOS 27. In India, prices could start at ₹79,900, although Apple has not yet confirmed any details regarding the launch.

sports.title: Barcelona told young German defender Finn Jeltsch ‘would fit perfectly’ in Hansi Flick’s side
sports.summary: Finn Jeltsch, a 20-year-old center-back from VfB Stuttgart, has garnered attention from FC Barcelona. Described as a “modern center-back” due to his anticipation and ball-playing skills, Jeltsch is seen as a strong fit for Hansi Flick's team. Despite being still in the development phase, his potential has led to interest from several clubs.

sports.title: WTA Finals: Mirra Andreeva eliminates Jessica Pegula to reach final, winning in straight sets after 'diva' criticism
sports.summary: Mirra Andreeva defeated Jessica Pegula in straight sets, 6-3 6-4, to advance to the final of the WTA Finals in Indian Wells. The match followed Pegula's earlier comments, where she referred to Andreeva as a "diva." With this victory, Andreeva became the first teenager to reach the title match at this year-end tournament in California.

sports.title: Eight sentenced to jail over Nurmagomedov-Dvalishvili Abu Dhabi hotel brawl
sports.summary: The Abu Dhabi Criminal Court has sentenced eight individuals to jail for their involvement in a brawl between MMA fighters Usman Nurmagomedov and Merab Dvalishvili, along with their teams, at a hotel. The incident occurred prior to a wrestling event organized by Real American Wrestling. A total of ten people were convicted in connection with the altercation.

health.title: Dr. Daniel Griffin: US Has Lost Measles Elimination as Cases Pass 5,400 and Medical Societies Break With RFK Jr.
health.summary: In a recent update, Dr. Daniel Griffin reported over 5,400 measles cases and 10 deaths in the U.S., indicating a concerning upward trend with no signs of stabilization. The country may soon lose its measles elimination status, which it has maintained for 26 years. Additionally, medical societies are distancing themselves from Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s views on vaccination.

health.title: 1 in 5 children with diabetes face mental health challenges: PGI study
health.summary: A PGI study involving 97 children with Type 1 diabetes in northern India found that 20% face mental health challenges, which are associated with poor HbA1c levels and increased hospitalizations. The findings, published in the Journal of Pediatric Endocrinology and Metabolism, highlight the need for regular mental health screening for these children to address their emotional well-being.

health.title: Exhibition, poster competitions held at CMC to mark World Diabetes Day
health.summary: Christian Medical College (CMC) hosted an awareness exhibition and poster competitions to celebrate World Diabetes Day 2026. Organized by the Department of Endocrinology, Diabetes & Metabolism, the event provided screening services for over 350 participants and included interactive educational sessions. The initiative aimed to raise awareness about diabetes and promote healthy lifestyle choices among attendees.

science.title: SpaceX’s Starship returns from orbit and is captured by launch pad arms in a dramatic first
science.summary: SpaceX’s Starship successfully returned to Earth on November 14, 2026, after a 22-hour mission, marking a significant milestone in reusability. The spacecraft was captured midair by mechanical arms at the launch pad, demonstrating advancements in SpaceX's technology. This event aligns with the company's broader goals of facilitating missions to the Moon and Mars in the future.

science.title: planet candidates in public NASA data — and he's funding the next wave with $100,000 grants — BigGo Finance
science.summary: An AI researcher utilized Claude and Codex agents to analyze public telescope archives, identifying potential asteroid and dwarf-planet candidates. This effort involved several weeks of work examining uncharted areas of the sky. To further support this research, the researcher is offering $100,000 grants for future projects aimed at exploring these celestial bodies using government-funded telescopes worldwide.

entertainment.title: Actor Mammootty’s punch dialogues to raise road safety awareness in Keralam
entertainment.summary: Actor Mammootty's famous dialogues are being utilized in Kerala's road safety campaign, spearheaded by the Motor Vehicles Department (MVD). Eye-catching boards on metro pillars feature these iconic lines to encourage responsible behavior among all road users. This innovative approach aims to raise awareness and promote safer driving practices throughout the state, leveraging Mammootty's popularity for a crucial message.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: November 15, 2026
entertainment.summary: On November 15, 2026, Capricorn is encouraged to release burdens and embrace change, despite initial discomfort. This period is ideal for establishing personal boundaries and reflecting on identity and aspirations. The horoscope emphasizes self-discovery and growth, urging individuals to consider their desired future and the steps needed to achieve it. Embracing this transformative phase is essential for personal development.

entertainment.title: A 13-year-old Seattle baseball fan picked up a free trading card at a Mariners game without knowing she had the only gold version in existence; weeks later, collectors paid $20,100 for the raccoon-the
entertainment.summary: A 13-year-old Seattle baseball fan unknowingly picked up a rare gold trading card at a Mariners game. This card, the only one of its kind, was later sold for $20,100 at an online auction. The young fan, Abby, expressed surprise at the card's value, highlighting the unexpected nature of collectible items in sports memorabilia.
